summary: The generic transport in MapTopology.lean reuses existing TauCeti API, but `BundleTest.homComplexificationCLE` re-assembles the new `BundleTest.mapCLE` by hand and re-proves its apply/symm/toLinearEquiv/tsupport lemmas. One compact-stage Hom lemma and one continuity proof also repeat what the PR already provides.
